answer: Audits are published in crystal, queued in whisper, and comet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 23 identities per epoch. A farm of 340 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4106 identities would post 2133 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
